findings.summary: setuptools: Windows path escape via namespace_packages.txt during legacy wheel installation  Description
findings.current_exposure: Broker Qwen activation disabled; no playback authorized.
findings.conditional_reachability: Windows-specific, but requires setuptools' legacy Wheel.install_as_egg on a malicious wheel. Runtime does not call it; uv installation does not use that legacy installer. Not a fix or assurance for arbitrary future package installs.

findings.summary: X-CLIP checkpoint conversion: unsafe deserialization
findings.current_exposure: Broker Qwen activation disabled; no playback authorized.
findings.conditional_reachability: X-CLIP checkpoint-conversion script is not called by the Qwen model path. Tensor-only private profile loading is a different code path.

findings.summary: huggingface/transformers: Arbitrary Code Execution During Model Initialization in the LightGlue Model Loading Path
findings.current_exposure: Broker Qwen activation disabled; no playback authorized.
findings.conditional_reachability: LightGlue model initialization is not used; reviewed model is qwen3_tts. Arbitrary model/config substitution must stay forbidden.

findings.summary: HuggingFace Transformers allows for arbitrary code execution in the `Trainer` class
findings.current_exposure: Broker Qwen activation disabled; no playback authorized.
findings.conditional_reachability: Trainer._load_rng_state is not used and advisory requires PyTorch <2.6; installed Torch is 2.11.0+cu128. Those preconditions are absent.

findings.summary: HuggingFace transformers vulnerable to remote code execution
findings.current_exposure: Broker Qwen activation disabled; no playback authorized.
findings.conditional_reachability: Model loading IS used. Malicious attention configuration can bypass remote-code trust checks. Fixed model revision and explicit SDPA constrain current input, but the original loader permits network/cache access; no sandbox or verified artifact-integrity proof currently closes this risk. Keep disabled.

findings.summary: Transformers save_pretrained path traversal allows arbitrary file writes through chat template names
findings.current_exposure: Broker Qwen activation disabled; no playback authorized.
findings.conditional_reachability: Requires save_pretrained with attacker-controlled chat-template names. Worker does not call model/tokenizer save_pretrained; profile torch.save is different.

findings.summary: Hugging Face Transformers downloads custom generation code before trust consent
findings.current_exposure: Broker Qwen activation disabled; no playback authorized.
findings.conditional_reachability: Generation/model initialization IS used. Requires attacker-controlled custom generation metadata. Fixed revision constrains input, but downloading before trust consent means trust_remote_code=False alone is insufficient. Keep disabled until patched or artifact/network restrictions are independently verified.
